title: Think in Safety: Unveiling and Mitigating Safety Alignment Collapse in Multimodal Large Reasoning Model
benchmark_measurement: This paper evaluates multimodal large reasoning models on general safety alignment across two main categories: jailbreak robustness and safety-awareness. The safety topics include broad categories like violence, discrimination, hate speech, and physical harm. While the 'discrimination' category could potentially include religion, the paper does not provide any specific analysis, benchmarks, or examples related to religious bias, stereotypes, or faith-based content.
findings: This paper does not analyze or report any findings related to religion or faith.
